observations.detail: Current guardian request is compared in full with setup-derived command, cwd, source identities and original 180 seconds. Actual owner schema, 180/3, subreaper, complete cleanup, ECHILD, leader reaped, remaining_direct_children=[], no cleanup errors/deadline are required before verify_source/capture_closed. No old remaining alias replaces the real field.

Source verification and capture are separate try blocks. Nonzero/interrupted/timed out child remains source HOLD while closed originals are still archived. Missing/malformed guardian or unclosed child publishes completed parent receipts and typed fixed metadata, not potentially live child bodies.

Natural acceptance requires original guard stable identities, exact source-only flags, rc0 before deadline, no timeout/interruption/owner error/overflow, the original four natural events and parent RUN command/cwd/environment/request; raw child logs and current inputs are rehashed.

Policy and original worker agree exactly on text/sort/note/cgraph order, 160 source files/2498584 bytes and original caps. Worker visits each fixed component once unless an outside/irrecoverable failure stops it; such partial output cannot pass final verification. Finalizer requires all four rows in original order and five original authoring/document/assembly/verified/caps files for each, matching full record identities and recomputed measures.

Original worker performs actual source authoring, public assembly/Core round trip and nine caps. Finalizer independently recomputes those nine measures from the verified document and actual assembly byte length. Complete 160-file namespace and source identity maps before/after/current are required. The 16384-line compiler gate is explicitly not measured; no native/17 CLI/46 trace execution is claimed.

After proven closure, namespace inventory is bounded to4096 entries; each regular file is single-linked/owned/nofollow/identity bound and completely retained subject to32MiB perfile/192MiB raw/256MiB tar. All actual tar members and bodies are independently read and hashed; original namespace and all captured file identities are reread. Nonregulars retain typed metadata, not opened targets. Typed/error/oversized refusals keep HOLD; optional error.txt absences remain explicit.

Selection is whole files only, priority includes actual HIA and cap files. Per-file bytes/SHA/Git identity and retained copy are checked. Total selected body remains512KiB, INDEX64KiB, emitted output including END <=1MiB. Whole omissions and missing originals are explicit. FRAMING.json and small.frames.txt are create-only, fsynced and independently read back before stdout emits the success END. END source_status preserves HOLD independently from transport completion.
